systems.country_label: Logiciel d'administration de l'état civil HERA
systems.platform: HERA (deployed by Edisoft Sénégal under PAMEC)
systems.owner: Promoted by the Centre National de l'Etat Civil (CNEC); installed by the EU-funded PAMEC project
systems.tiers: 83 civil registration centres as of April 2019 (80 in the 2017 deployment reports cited); no connection of the centres is stated and the study says no consolidated national civil register exists

systems.system: Système centralisé de gestion de l'état civil (proposed)
systems.country_label: Registre d'état civil national et centralisé
systems.owner: Proposed; the Direction de l'état civil and its CNEC hold the mandate to coordinate computerisation of civil registration centres (decree 2018-1573)
systems.tiers: A recommendation of the study, to be fed from existing municipal civil register databases and digitised paper registers; not built

note: A feasibility study of identity and civil registration files: it states nothing about a data connection at commune offices; the identity-card and passport systems it describes run in police stations, which are central field offices.
